answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a small refundable stake that vests slowly over time, like a river delta building land grain by grain. A newcomer holds no atlas of trusted counterparties yet, so its first jobs are tiny and closely reviewed. Only after many verified completions does its standing rise to a mesa — high, visible, and hard to fake at scale, because manufacturing hundreds of such histories costs more than the rewards they could steal.
